location.hint: Fills in your address and helps find the right ward office.

location.weak: The GPS signal is weak, so the address may be off. Please check it.
location.noAddress: We found your position but not the address. Please type it.
landing.hero.title: Say it. We write the letter.
landing.hero.lead: Describe a civic problem in Tamil or English, add a photo, and Kural prepares the right government document for you.
landing.hero.note: No account needed · Tamil and English
landing.sheet.title: Complaint letter
landing.sheet.to: To: the right office, chosen by fixed rules
landing.sheet.subject: Subject: your complaint
landing.sheet.label: What happened?
landing.sheet.placeholder: The streetlight on Gandhi Street has not worked for three weeks…
landing.sheet.hint: Next you can record your voice and add photos.
landing.how.title: From your voice to a letter
landing.how.1.title: Say it
landing.how.1.body: Record up to 30 seconds in Tamil or English, or type. Add up to three photos.
landing.how.2.title: We check
landing.how.2.body: Kural reads your words and checks that the photo matches. If something is missing, it asks. It never guesses.
landing.how.3.title: Get the letter
landing.how.3.body: A bilingual PDF, fields ready to paste into the CM Helpline form, and the next steps read aloud.
landing.where.title: The rules choose where it goes
landing.where.note: The AI reads your complaint. Fixed rules, not the AI, pick the office, the department and the wording.
landing.where.local.body: Streetlights, garbage, roads, drainage and water.
landing.where.cm.body: When the local office has not acted, or the problem crosses departments.
landing.where.rti.body: When you want records: who decided, and what was spent.
landing.trust.title: Plain, private, and yours to check
landing.trust.1.title: No account
landing.trust.1.body: Start right away. There is nothing to sign up for.
landing.trust.2.title: Works offline too
landing.trust.2.body: On a kiosk, Kural can run its AI on the same machine, with no internet.
landing.trust.3.title: You review everything
landing.trust.3.body: You read and edit the text before any document is made.
landing.cta.title: Ready when you are
landing.cta.body: Start with one sentence. Kural does the paperwork.
